room_backgrounds.creation_method: Project-owned OpenAI ImageGen workflows; original humanist/handscroll synthesis on a fixed 960x640 three-quarter game camera
room_backgrounds.modifications: baked-prop removal, exact-scene color-boundary repaints per variant, geometry-locked selection, resize and JPEG encoding; 6A v1/v2 file contents were exchanged so its donor-matched study is consistently named v1
room_backgrounds.runtime_selection: surface seed picks one of the three background studies per room

runtime_live_backgrounds.creation_method: Three 960x640 owner-edited JPEG donor plates supplied as 2.jpg for 6A, 1.jpg for 6B and 6cnew.jpg for 6C
runtime_live_backgrounds.modifications: copied byte-for-byte into versioned runtime paths; all white and near-white pixels are strictly excluded from the animated layer and a pure-transparent gutter surrounds each white edge; runtime computes one full-screen boundary-distance field per logical white region and advances an independently phased, very soft alpha annulus to the screen edges before fading it away; all wave cycles are 20% slower than the preceding preset; 6C directly uses the owner's seven disconnected white decision regions without clustering
runtime_live_backgrounds.runtime_selection: one room-specific donor is decoded for a Live challenge and alpha-composited over fixed shell v1 in all three rooms; non-Live challenges retain normal surface selection

runtime_effect_textures.creation_method: OpenAI ImageGen monochrome fog density source on black
runtime_effect_textures.modifications: downsampled to 512x341 PNG; black is converted to alpha once after image decode
runtime_effect_textures.runtime_selection: disabled in every formal game room and retained for provenance only; GameCanvas neither requests nor draws white fog

prop_sprites.creation_method: OpenAI ImageGen on chroma plates plus project-owned chroma-removal, alpha-crop and variant-review workflow
prop_sprites.modifications: four humanist figure groups with reviewed V1/V2/V3 skins (rejected studies intentionally copy V1) and two 6C garden anchors separated from the shell
prop_sprites.runtime_selection: six layout instances select a deterministic V1/V2/V3 skin by challenge seed; missing variants fall back to V1

layout.creation_method: Editor-authored room layout, floor, portal, spawn, per-instance collision-pad and irregular collision contract
layout.modifications: copied byte-for-byte from the recorded source commit

underlying_work.artist_reference: Humanist-dome room deliberately adapts the COMPOSITION of two public-domain masterworks — Michelangelo's Creation of Adam (Sistine Chapel, 1512) and Raphael's School of Athens (1511): the reaching-hands figures and the coffered domed architecture. Handscroll room is original blue-green (qinglu) landscape synthesis, not a copy of any one specific scroll (its red seal is a decorative invented mark, not a reproduced artist's seal). Blank-canvas room is original.
underlying_work.public_domain_basis: Michelangelo d.1564 and Raphael d.1520 — works long in the public domain; composition and style of public-domain works are freely reusable. Assets are project-drawn re-renderings (own OpenAI ImageGen), NOT photographic reproductions, so no photographer's copyright attaches.
underlying_work.claim: Newly drawn project game art. The humanist-dome room is an intentional, acknowledged homage to the above public-domain compositions; no modern/copyrighted image and no museum scan is embedded.

human_author_contribution: Art direction, prompts, concept selection, geometry constraints, baked-prop removal decisions, sprite crop and alpha review, figure-variant acceptance/rejection, layout authorship, collision tuning and runtime composition; requires formal documentation review.
blocking_checks: Verify every generated source ID and each geometry/reference-image permission
Document human-authored modifications per production asset
Run similarity review against specific paintings, artists and competing games (esp. School of Athens / Sistine gesture references)
Review art-house naming, endorsement implication and Painterly Chameleon trademark
Approve public commercial use or replace blocked assets
